title.purpose: Page titles at 16px / 650; Nuudo wordmark at 16px / 750.

body.purpose: App default 13px / 400 / 1.45 Inter. Panel titles share 13px at 650.

label.purpose: Table headers, chips, form labels, and confidence pills at 11px / 650.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Hairline companion on resting panels, explorer, and selected segmented tabs.

shadows.name: rest-dark

shadows.name: dialog

shadows.name: drawer

shadows.name: focus-ring

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid corporate-blue action for connect, save, and continue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-hover); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline companion action beside a primary in save bars and empty states.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--bg-muted); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet chrome control for revealing a collapsed panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { border-color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Icon Tool
components.description: 32px header and panel tool for add, manage, theme, and collapse.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-tool" type="button" aria-label="Agregar fuente"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-tool { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--muted); border-radius: 7px; display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-tool:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-icon-tool:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); } .ds-icon-tool:active { color: var(--text); }

components.name: Source Pill
components.description: Connected-source chip in the sticky header chrome.
components.css: .ds-source-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-source-pill:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-source-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); }

components.name: Confidence Pill
components.description: Percent badge: teal high, amber medium, rose low.
components.css: .ds-confidence { border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-confidence-high { color: var(--success); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent); } .ds-confidence-medium { color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-soft); } .ds-confidence-low { color: var(--red); background: var(--red-soft); } .ds-confidence:hover { filter: brightness(0.97); } .ds-confidence:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); }

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: 8px elevated panel with 64px heading, stat chips, and hairline rest shadow.
components.html:
Revisión

Confirma lo dudoso antes de seguir.

4 pendientes
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-elevated); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--text); } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 64px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-panel-head p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-stat-warn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-soft); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 22%, transparent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); }

components.name: Connector Field
components.description: 13px form field on canvas fill with corporate-blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); outline: none; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); }

components.name: Concept Item
components.description: Explorer row: 8px, 28px blue icon well, active blue wash.
components.css: .ds-concept { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-concept:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); } .ds-concept-active { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line)); } .ds-concept:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); } .ds-concept-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--bg-muted); color: var(--accent); border-radius: 7px; } .ds-concept-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; } .ds-concept-copy strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-concept-copy small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-confidence-mini { border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--success); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Setup Stepper
components.description: Fully rounded chrome track with 20px circle indices; current fills corporate blue.
components.html: Map2Negocio
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; background: var(--bg-muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px 4px 6px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted); padding: 4px 0; } .ds-step strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); } .ds-step-index { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-current .ds-step-index { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); } .ds-step-current strong { color: var(--text); } .ds-step-done .ds-step-index { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--line)); color: var(--accent); } .ds-step-line { width: 18px; height: 1px; background: var(--line-strong); margin-right: 8px; } .ds-step:hover strong { color: var(--text); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring); border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview:
Nuudo's shipped Map is a dense corporate operations desk: sticky product chrome, source pills in the header, and two working panels where structure is listed and confirmations are decided in a table. The atmosphere is quiet, light, and exacting. Surfaces sit on cool slate paper with hairline borders. Corporate blue is the only action color; it marks the current step, primary buttons, selection, and focus. Teal, amber, and rose speak only as confidence and status.

The system is Inter at 13px, not a marketing site. Density is the point: a 56px sticky header, 64px panel heads, 26px stat chips, compact pills. Light on cool paper is the canonical theme. Dark is a paired night desk on the same geometry and type ramp, not a second identity.

The wordmark is Nuudo at 16px / 750 beside the 30×30 `/nuudo-icon.png` mark, clipped to 8px. New surfaces inherit this ledger, not a looser marketing layout.
keyCharacteristics: Cool slate paper with a single corporate-blue accent
Inter at 13px with a tight 26 / 22 / 16 / 13 / 11 ramp
Hairline borders and a 1px rest shadow; large shadows only on overlays
Dual light/dark themes sharing one geometry

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Corporate blue is the only action color. Teal, amber, and rose are status, never chrome.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: Selection, confidence, pending, and danger sit on translucent washes, not solid blocks.

rules.name: The Thirteen Rule
rules.body: Body copy, chrome, and forms are 13px Inter. 16px is page title and wordmark; 26px is the selected concept name only.

rules.name: The Two-Panel Desk Rule
rules.body: The working canvas is a two-column grid (structure | review) with 10px gutters, a sticky 56px header, and 64px panel heads. Below 1100px the columns stack.

rules.name: The Hairline Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use a 1px line plus the 1px rest shadow. Large shadows are overlay-only.

rules.name: The Seven-and-Pill Rule
rules.body: Controls are 7px. Workspace panels are 8px. Status, sources, and the stepper live at 999px.

dos: Do use Corporate Blue for primary actions, the current step, selected rows, and the 3px focus ring.
Do keep light tokens as the canonical values and restyle through the existing dark variables.
Do set body at 13px Inter; page titles and the wordmark at 16px; concept names at 26px.
Do use 7px radius on buttons, icon tools, and fields; 8px on workspace panels; 999px on pills and the stepper.
Do mark selection with Corporate Blue Wash, not a heavy fill or a rest-surface drop shadow.
Do keep the wordmark Nuudo at 16px / 750 beside `/nuudo-icon.png` at 30×30, 8px.
donts: Don't use green (or any second hue) as the action accent. Corporate blue is the only accent; teal is confirmation status.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a display serif. Inter is the single UI voice.
Don't rest-elevate panels with large drop shadows; only drawers and dialogs lift.
Don't square off source pills, confidence badges, or the stepper track.
Don't treat placeholder next-step cards as the layout system for new screens.
Don't put an uppercase eyebrow or kicker above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.
